此工作流程的作用

👉大家好！ 🎉 我很高兴向您介绍专为广告目的而设计的“Joy is Bavaria”工作流程。

想象一下：您上传一张照片，然后立即获得人工智能生成的您穿着传统巴伐利亚皮裤的图像。 🥨🍻这不仅仅是有趣；这是与品牌互动的独特方式。在你的新巴伐利亚外观的左上角，有一个人工智能生成的公司徽标，不是我的，而是客户的。它与朗朗上口的口号相结合：“欢乐是巴伐利亚”。

对于喜欢定制的用户，可以使用 ControlNet 和 IP_Adapter 对徽标进行微调。为了完成巴伐利亚主题，图像的每个角都有一面迷人的蓝白格子旗 - 标志性的巴伐利亚图案！

广告工作流程特点：

借助 IP 适配器和 WD14Tagger，可以对性别、肤色和面部进行高级检测。这个工作流程具有最大程度的包容性——我们甚至欢迎外星人的照片！ 👽

巴伐利亚皮裤采用经过专门训练的 LoRa 模型制作而成。看看这里：巴伐利亚皮裤模型。

图像质量一流，分辨率可提升至 1792 x 2034。📸

根据需要自定义徽标、营销文本和旗帜的功能。

自动创建面罩可确保每次都能完美贴合。

如何使用此工作流程

👉

下载“巴伐利亚皮裤 [SDXL]" 来自 Civitai 的 LoRa 并将其保存在您的 comfyui/models/lora/ 文件夹中。

将您自己的照片上传到 Load_face_image 节点，然后单击“生成”。

关于此工作流程的提示

👉 我在工作流程中包含了许多预览节点，使其透明且易于理解 - 您将准确地看到正在发生的情况以及每个节点如何影响结果。我将其设计为用户友好且直观。

🎥 视频演示链接（可选）

👉  https://youtu.be/-E6Haa68fbo

迫不及待地想让您尝试一下，直接从屏幕上体验巴伐利亚！

o.en:
What this workflow does

👉 Hey everyone! 🎉 I'm thrilled to introduce the "Joy is Bavaria" Workflow, specifically designed for advertising purposes.

Picture this: You upload a photo and instantly get an AI-generated image of yourself in traditional Bavarian lederhosen. 🥨🍻 It’s not just fun; it's a unique way to engage with a brand. In the top-left corner of your new Bavarian look, there’s an AI-generated logo of a company, not mine, but a client's. It's paired with the catchy slogan, "Joy is Bavaria."

For those who enjoy customization, the logo can be finely adjusted using ControlNet and the IP_Adapter. And to complete the Bavarian theme, each corner of the image features a charming blue and white checkered flag – the iconic Bavarian pattern!

Workflow Features for Advertising:

Advanced detection of gender, skin color, and face, thanks to the IP-Adapter and WD14Tagger. This workflow is inclusive to the max – we even welcome photos of extraterrestrial beings! 👽

The Bavarian lederhosen are crafted using a specially trained LoRa model. Take a peek here: Bavarian Lederhosen Model.

Image quality is top-notch with upscaling to 1792 x 2034. 📸

Customize the logo, marketing text, and the features of the flag as desired.

Automatic mask creation ensures a perfect fit every time.

How to use this workflow

👉

Download the "Bavarian Lederhosen [SDXL]" LoRa from Civitai and save it in your comfyui/models/lora/ folder.

Upload a photo of yourself to the Load_face_image Node and click on generate.

Tips about this workflow

👉 I've included numerous preview nodes in the workflow to make it transparent and easy to understand – you'll see exactly what's happening and how each node influences the outcome. I've designed it to be user-friendly and intuitive.

🎥 Video demo link (optional)

👉  https://youtu.be/-E6Haa68fbo

Can't wait for you to try it out and experience a slice of Bavaria, right from your screen!
